messages.text: Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2

Good to know. The T. P2 is 10 TH/s at about 166 W, so at 12¢ you're looking at roughly $15 a month in power to run it — it's $369 right now, down from $449.

What's holding it back is hashrate per dollar. Tell me your state (or country) and I'll run the actual sats and break-even for you, and show you how it stacks against the Magic Miner 40T.

Germany changes the answer. Two things:

Power dominates. The Magic Miner 40T is far better value per TH ($799 for 40 TH/s vs $369 for 10 TH/s), but it pulls ~650 W — about 475 kWh a month. At typical German retail that's well over €100 a month. The T. P2's 166 W is ~120 kWh, roughly €35 at 30¢.

Also: the P2 ships from our US warehouse, so 21% import VAT isn't included and duties are yours on delivery. It ships Oct 3, 2026.

What do you actually pay per kWh?

At 35¢, honestly: neither unit is profitable in Germany. That's a stacking-sats and lottery-ticket play, not income. Worth being clear before you spend.

On that rate the Thor P2 costs you about €42 a month to run. The 40T is about €166 a month, even in Eco (450 W) it's €115. Four times the hashrate, four times the burn.

So at 35¢ the P2 is the sane buy. Want me to build the cart?
